decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - That condition 9  of the Planning Permission , ref: 00647/B/P8 dated  30/3/06 for the erection of a 6.25m high marquee for use as events marquee on a seasonal basis for 3 years in the grounds of Osterley Park, be replaced with the wording:-

"The application hereby approved shall operate between 12 midday to 11.30pm Monday to Saturday and no events shall take place on Sundays".

Condition : 2 - It is considered that the amendment to Condition 9 is acceptable and  the proposal to use the marquee for earlier opening during the day, excluding Sunday, would not adversely affect the Listed Building, the historic park and gardens, the Conservation Area or the surrounding residential properties.  The proposal is considered to be an acceptable variation to Condition 9 of the Planning Permission in accordance with the relevant Council policies ENVB 1.1 (New Development),  ENVB 2.2 (Conservation Areas), ENVB 2.5  (Development affecting the setting of a Listed Building), ENVN 1.5 (Protection of MOL),  ENVN 1.6 (Metropolitan Open Land Acceptable Uses),  ENVN 1.9  (Metropolitan Open Land Improvements),  ENVN 1.15 (Heritage Land),  ENVN 1.16 (Historic Parks and Gardens), T.1.4 (Car and cycle parking and servicing facilities for Developments) and  Supplementary Planning Guidance, Osterley Park Conservation Area of the Unitary Development Plan, (December 2003).
description: Variation of Condition 9 of Planning Permission for temporary marque dated 30 March 2006 from approved hours of from 6pm Monday to Friday and 2.30pm on Saturdays. The use shall cease no later than 11.30pm Monday to Saturday. To proposed hours of 12 Midday to 11.30pm Monday to Saturday.
